statsd.description: Configuration for StatsD backend: host, port, and behavior.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the StatsD server to send metrics to.

port.description: UDP port on which the StatsD server listens for metrics.

prefix.description: Prefix prepended to all metric names (e.g., 'ejabberd.prod' → 'ejabberd.prod.sessions.active').

flush_interval.description: Time interval (in milliseconds) between metric flushes to StatsD.

enabled.description: Whether the StatsD module is active. Disable to stop metric reporting without removing the module.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging of StatsD packets for troubleshooting.

metric_types.description: Optional list of custom metric types to override defaults (e.g., ['counter', 'gauge', 'timer']). Leave empty for defaults.

enabled.description: Enable filtering to send only selected stat categories.

include.description: List of stat categories to include (e.g., users, roster, muc, s2s, vcard, disco).
